plan.angle: The top 10 is places to play (Sporcle, FunTrivia, Britannica, Game Night Live, Trivia Plaza), question lists and two videos, and none helps a host run a trivia quiz of their own with scoring and a leaderboard. This page lets the searcher play an 8-question trivia quiz on the page, with a sourced answer behind every question, then shows four hosts, a bar, a teacher, an office and a library fundraiser, running their own quiz as an app that scores every answer into a table they own.
tab_stories: Tidewater Tap runs a Tuesday pub quiz for 11 teams with 6 rounds of 5 questions answered on one phone per team, the app posts the leaderboard to the bar TV after each round, and The Fact Hounds win on 27 of 30.

A science teacher at Pinecrest Ridge Middle School gives 3 classes, 84 students, a 12-question Friday review, and any question missed by more than half the students goes on Monday's reteach list, this week the moon-phase question missed by 51 of 84.
Calloway Freight runs a 15-question lunch trivia quiz once a month for 62 staff in 3 offices, scores are averaged per office, and Omaha takes the month on an average of 11.4.

The Friends of the Maple Hollow Library run a 40-question fundraiser trivia night for 18 teams, two teams tie at 34, and the tiebreaker goes to the closest guess to the number of books the library lent last year.
